name: E-commerce brands
summary: Lanternfield Automation automates operations for direct-to-consumer and small e-commerce brands: customer service, returns handling, product content, review management and marketplace reporting. Buyers are brand owners and e-commerce managers with steady order volume.

industries.dtc_brand: A direct-to-consumer brand selling its own physical products online (fashion, food, beauty, home, supplements)
industries.online_retailer: An online shop reselling third-party products, possibly across marketplaces such as Amazon or Zalando
industries.subscription_box: A subscription commerce business shipping recurring boxes or consumables
industries.shopify_agency: An agency building and running online shops for e-commerce clients

geography: Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Benelux and the UK

brand_owner.description: Founder or owner of the brand or shop

ecommerce_manager.description: E-commerce manager, head of digital or shop manager

head_of_customer_service.description: Customer service lead or head of support

marketing_lead.description: Head of marketing, performance marketing manager or CRM manager

customer_service_volume.description: Order status, returns and product questions flood the inbox and social channels

returns_handling.description: Returns and exchanges are processed by hand; refunds are slow

product_content.description: Writing and translating product descriptions, variants and marketplace listings is slow

marketplace_reporting.description: Sales, ad and inventory numbers from several channels are stitched together manually

review_management.description: Reviews and ratings are not monitored or answered consistently

disqualifiers.hobby_shop: A hobby shop or side project with very few orders, or explicitly no budget
disqualifiers.enterprise: A large retailer or corporate group with hundreds or thousands of employees
disqualifiers.competitor: The company sells e-commerce automation, AI agents or automation consulting itself
disqualifiers.student_or_academic: A student, researcher, journalist or job seeker asking for an interview or a job

intent_signals: asks for a call or proposal

warm.label: SDR sequence A
warm.action: 3-step sequence with the e-commerce case study
